name: inline-jsdoc-hints
description: Shows the JSDoc summary of a symbol inline in the VS Code completion list row, without requiring the documentation panel to be expanded.

commands.title: Inline JSDoc Hints: Add Plugin to tsconfig.json
Inline JSDoc Hints: Remove Plugin from tsconfig.json

inlineJsdocHints.enabled.description: Master on/off switch for Inline JSDoc Hints.

inlineJsdocHints.maxLength.description: Maximum characters of the JSDoc first sentence shown inline. Truncated with '…' if longer.

enumDescriptions: Up to the first '. ' or end of text.
inlineJsdocHints.extractionStrategy.description: Controls how the JSDoc description is extracted.

inlineJsdocHints.showInDetail.description: When true, appends the description to the existing detail field (type signature) instead of labelDetails.description.

inlineJsdocHints.includeLanguages.description: Languages the fallback CompletionItemProvider activates for.

inlineJsdocHints.fallbackProviderEnabled.description: Enable the fallback CompletionItemProvider (for non-TS workspaces or when the TS plugin is unavailable).

inlineJsdocHints.ignoredSymbolPrefixes.description: Completion item labels starting with any of these strings are skipped (e.g., ['__', '$internal']).

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/compileTests.js && node dist/test/runTests.js
